title: The Flesh of the Orchid
writer: James Hadley Chase, Jean-Claude Carrière, Patrice Chéreau
actors: Charlotte Rampling, Bruno Cremer, Edwige Feuillère
plot: A disturbed young woman is kept prisoner in a castle by her aunt for her money. The game-keeper, her guardian, tries to rape her but she escapes. In her flight she meets a man also running away, from two killers.
